differences: Inspecting the actual independent-host screenshot exposed horizontal clipping: min-height transferred through aspect-ratio and expanded an auto-width island container beyond its scene.
suggestions: Constrain the island container to its parent's width and assert nested scene overflow, not just document overflow or programmatically scrolled hit targets.
reasoning: The established rounded scene hid the overflow, so earlier page-level checks missed it. An explicit inline-size constraint preserves the original geometry while making all columns visible without hidden-container scrolling.
